How city trees cool a neighborhood

Trees cool streets by casting shade and releasing water through their leaves.

A healthy canopy can also make a walking route quieter and more comfortable.

What planners can measure

  • Surface temperature before and after planting.
  • Shade coverage at different times of day.
  • Tree survival during the first three summers.
Planting is the beginning of the work, not the end.
